title: Microsoft 365 Token-Replay Attacks Compromise 97 Accounts at 79 Organizations
summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed a Microsoft 365 campaign that has been observed leveraging an adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) relay to capture sign-in sessions and then replay the stolen tokens to break into email accounts at 79 organizations.

title: Gheist Uses Stolen GitHub Tokens to Steal Private Repository Secrets via Actions Logs
summary: An automated campaign is using stolen GitHub tokens to plant workflows that print a repository's secrets into its GitHub Actions logs, which the attackers then download before deleting the runs. The attacks have succeeded in private repositories and GitHub Enterprise environments, according to an analysis by cloud security company Wiz.

title: Malicious File in Downloads Folder Tries to Trick AI Coding Agent Into Installing Malware
summary: A malicious instruction file sitting in a developer's Downloads folder tried to make their AI coding agent install a known-malicious npm package, security firm Forever Security said in a report published last week.
card_summary: A malicious instruction file sitting in a developer's Downloads folder tried to make their AI coding agent install a known-malicious npm package, security firm Forever Security said in a report published last week.

sections.impact:
The company caught the attempt on a real customer's machine and stopped the agent before any code ran.

Assessed severity: MEDIUM.
